children: Climeon is on site at SMM 2026 in Hamburg, 1–4 September, to meet with shipowners, shipyards and other stakeholders across the maritime industry. Meet Climeon’s marine team and new Head of Marine, Marcus Sannholm, in Hall A1, Booth 107 to discuss HeatPower and how waste heat recovery can contribute to more energy-efficient vessel operation.

At SMM, Climeon is showcasing HeatPower and how ORC waste heat recovery can be applied to both newbuild and existing vessels to improve energy efficiency, reduce fuel consumption, and lower emissions.

Joining the team at SMM is Climeon’s new Head of Marine, Marcus Sannholm, who will lead the company’s marine sales and business development activities. Marcus has extensive experience from the maritime industry, most recently as Head of Sales at Norsepower, where he was responsible for the company’s sales. Prior to that, he held several commercial and technical roles at Alfa Laval, working closely with shipowners, shipyards and other global customers.

Climeon’s recently published white paper on marine ORC-based waste heat recovery is also available at SMM. The paper draws on the company’s experience from marine installations and can be downloaded via the link below.
Meet Marcus and the Climeon marine team at SMM, 1–4 September, Hall A1, Booth 107.

Climeon is a Swedish product company operating within the energy technology sector. Climeon's proprietary technology, the Climeon HeatPower system, uses an Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) process to convert low-temperature heat into clean, carbon free electricity. Providing access to dependable and cost-effective sustainable power, HeatPower enables industries to increase energy efficiency, decrease fuel consumption, and reduce emissions. As a non-weather-dependent source of green energy, HeatPower has the potential to diversify and safeguard the renewable energy mix and, therefore, accelerate the global transition to a net-zero future. Climeon's B shares are listed on the Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market. FNCA Sweden AB is a Certified Adviser. Learn more at climeon.com.
